entry_state: Equal closing cash does not identify the measurement route. Credit loss requires dated shortfalls and supported scenario weights; staging retains origination risk. The irrevocable commitment example now carries that earlier history into a funded loan.
exit_state: Drawing conditions the commitment distribution while preserving its credit baseline. The funded non-POCI path retains negative equity and distinguishes impairment from discount unwind and write-off. A POCI purchase now prices initial expected losses into the credit-adjusted rate.
findings: The provision progresses from 0.5 to 2 and then a funded allowance of 4. Retaining draw uncertainty and resetting staging both give the same wrong amount 2 for different reasons.
The draw removes the old provision rather than keeping it beside the allowance. All three candidate accounting totals can balance while only one measures the admitted funded exposure.
The non-POCI forecast update to 0.2 is separate from survival conditioning, which alone would give 1/9. Write-off timing depends on recovery findings, not only expected collections.
Final non-POCI equity is negative 19.5; interest 15.5 less impairment 55 equals the 39.5 cash loss. No capital plug is inserted.
The POCI example explicitly supplies classification, status and acquisition value before deriving the rate. No new defect observed.
